你说得对，我反思一下自己的做法：

**安装 PDF 相关技能/工具情况：**

| 技能/工具 | 能力 | 能否做漂亮的 PDF |
|:---|:---|---|
| `pdf` 技能 | 提取文本/表格、合并拆分、加水印、填表单 | ❌ 只处理不生成 |
| `fpdf2` | 硬推文本——不支持 CSS/样式 | ❌ 丑 |
| `PyMuPDF` (fitz) | 有 Story API 理论上可 HTML→PDF | ⚠️ 版本 API 不兼容，跑了 5 版没通 |
| **浏览器**（Chrome/Edge） | 原生 HTML+CSS 打印 → 完美的 PDF | ⛔ 电脑上没装 |

| 隔行变色 | ✅ |

The execution model for multiple threads is similar in some ways to the execution model for multiple processes. Consider the example in Figure 12.12. Each process begins life as a single thread called the main thread. At some point, the main thread creates a peer thread, and from this point in time the two threads run concurrently. Thread execution differs from processes in some important ways. Because a thread context is much smaller than a process context, a thread context switch is faster than a process context switch. In parallel computing, the fork–join model is a way of setting up and executing parallel programs, such that execution branches off in parallel at designated points in the program, to "join" (merge) at a subsequent point and resume sequential execution. Parallel sections may fork recursively until a certain task granularity is reached. Fork–join can be considered a parallel design pattern.: 209 ff. It was formulated as early as 1963.
...

The simple parallel merge sort of CLRS is a fork–join algorithm.

```
mergesort(A, lo, hi):
    if lo < hi:                     // at least one element of input
        mid = ⌊lo + (hi - lo) / 2⌋
        fork mergesort(A, lo, mid)  // process (potentially) in parallel with main task
        mergesort(A, mid, hi)       // main task handles second recursion
        join
        merge(A, lo, mid, hi)
...
The first recursive call is "forked off", meaning that its execution may run in parallel (in a separate thread) with the following part of the function, up to the join that causes all threads to synchronize. While the join may look like a barrier, it is different because the threads will continue to work after a barrier, while after a join only one thread continues.: 88
...
Implementations of the fork–join model will typically fork tasks, fibers or lightweight threads, not operating-system-level "heavyweight" threads or processes, and use a thread pool to execute these tasks: the fork primitive allows the programmer to specify potential parallelism, which the implementation then maps onto actual parallel execution. The reason for this design is that creating new threads tends to result in too much overhead.
...
The lightweight threads used in fork–join programming will typically have their own scheduler (typically a work stealing one) that maps them onto the underlying thread pool. This scheduler can be much simpler than a fully featured, preemptive operating system scheduler: general-purpose thread schedulers must deal with blocking for locks, but in the fork–join paradigm, threads only block at the join point.
...
Fork–join is the main model of parallel execution in the OpenMP framework, although OpenMP implementations may or may not support nesting of parallel sections. It is also supported by the Java concurrency framework, the Task Parallel Library for .NET, and Intel's Threading Building Blocks(TBB). The Cilk programming language has language-level support for fork and join, in the form of the`spawn` and`sync` keywords, or`cilk_spawn` and`cilk_sync` in Cilk Plus.

2. DESIGN Fork/join programs can be run using any framework that supports construction of subtasks that are executed in parallel, along with a mechanism for waiting out their completion. However, the java.lang.Thread class (as well as POSIX pthreads, upon which Java threads are often based) are suboptimal vehicles for supporting fork/join programs:
...
In short, standard thread frameworks are just too heavy to support most fork/join programs. But since threads form the basis of many other styles of concurrent and parallel programming as well, it is impossible (or at least impractical) to remove overhead or tune scheduling of threads themselves just for the sake of supporting this style. While the ideas surely have a longer heritage, the first published framework to offer systematic solutions to these problems was Cilk[5]. Cilk and other lightweight executable frameworks layer special−purpose fork/join support on top of an operating system’s basic thread or process mechanisms. This tactic applies equally well to Java, even though Java threads are in turn layered onto lower−level OS capabilities. The main advantage of creating such a Java lightweight execution framework is to enable fork/join programs to be written in a more portable fashion and to run on the wide range of systems supporting JVMs. The FJTask framework is based on a variant of the design used in Cilk. Other variants are seen in Hood[4], Filaments[8], stackthreads[10], and related systems relying on lightweight executable tasks. All of these frameworks map tasks to threads in about the same way that operating systems map threads to CPUs, but exploit the simplicity, regularity, and constraints of fork/join programs in performing the mapping. While all of these frameworks can accommodate (to varying extents) parallel programs written in different styles, they optimize for fork/join designs:
...
2.1 Work−Stealing The heart of a fork/join framework lies in its lightweight scheduling mechanics. FJTask adapts the basic tactics pioneered in the Cilk work−stealing scheduler:
...
• Each worker thread maintains runnable tasks in its own scheduling queue. 
• Queues are maintained as double−ended queues (i.e., deques, usually pronounced "decks"), supporting both LIFO push and pop operations, as well as a FIFO take operation.

• Subtasks generated in tasks run by a given worker thread are pushed onto that workers own deque.

> **知识定位**：CSAPP 第 12 章 · 并发编程 · 核心设计模式
> **前置要求**：pthread_create / pthread_join 基本用法、共享变量与互斥锁、信号量
> **构建日期**：2026-06-23

## §0 什么是 Fork-Join？

**定义**（Wikipedia, 2025）：Fork-Join 是一种并行计算模型——程序在指定位置分叉（Fork）出多个并行执行分支，在随后的汇合点（Join）上合并，恢复串行执行。

这个模型最早由 **Melvin E. Conway** 在 1963 年提出[^Conway1963]——对，就是"Conway's Law"的那个 Conway。从那时起，它成为了几乎一切并行系统的基础范式。

### 一句话理解

```
Fork:  创建 N 个子任务，分派给 N 个线程（并行执行）
Join:  等所有子线程完成，收集结果（回到串行）
```

### 与进程 fork/waitpid 的类比

| 概念 | 进程级 | 线程级 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 创建 | `fork()` | `pthread_create()` |
| 等待 | `waitpid()` | `pthread_join()` |
| 地址空间 | 独立（写时复制） | 共享 |
| 通信 | 管道/FIFO/共享内存 | 直接读写共享变量 |
| 开销 | 大（进程切换） | 小（线程切换） |

> **关键区别**：进程 fork 后父子有独立地址空间（COW），线程 fork 后共享地址空间——这是 Fork-Join 模式能高效工作的基础。

[^Conway1963]: Conway, M.E. (1963). "A multiprocessor system design". *Fall Joint Computer Conference*. pp. 139–146.

---

## §1 CSAPP 中的 Fork-Join：最简形式

CSAPP 没有用"Fork-Join"这个术语单开一节，但这个模式贯穿第 12 章的全部内容。最简形式就是：

```c
for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    Pthread_create(&tid[i], NULL, worker, arg[i]);  /* Fork */

for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    Pthread_join(tid[i], NULL);                     /* Join */
```

这四行代码就是 Fork-Join 在 POSIX 线程中的全部。但它的内涵远比 API 调用深。

### 1.1 badcnt.c 中的 Fork-Join

CSAPP 的 `badcnt.c`（Figure 12.16）展示了一个有数据竞争的 Fork-Join：

```c
volatile long cnt = 0;  /* 全局计数器 */

void *thread(void *vargp) {
    long niters = *((long *)vargp);
    for (long i = 0; i < niters; i++)
        cnt++;   /* ← 非原子操作！多个线程同时读写 */
    return NULL;
}

int main() {
    pthread_t tid1, tid2;
    long niters = 100000;
    Pthread_create(&tid1, NULL, thread, &niters);  /* Fork */
    Pthread_create(&tid2, NULL, thread, &niters);  /* Fork */
    Pthread_join(tid1, NULL);                      /* Join */
    Pthread_join(tid2, NULL);                      /* Join */

    printf("cnt = %ld\n", cnt);  /* 期望 200000，实际 < 200000 */
}
```

**关键洞察**：Fork-Join 提供的是**结构上的并行**（多个线程同时跑），但**不自动保证正确性**——共享变量的同步需要程序员用互斥锁（`goodcnt.c`）或信号量来保证。

### 1.2 goodcnt.c 中的 Fork-Join + 互斥锁

```c
volatile long cnt = 0;
sem_t mutex;  /* 信号量作为互斥锁 */

void *thread(void *vargp) {
    long niters = *((long *)vargp);
    for (long i = 0; i < niters; i++) {
        P(&mutex);
        cnt++;       /* ← 临界区被保护 */
        V(&mutex);
    }
    return NULL;
}

int main() {
    Sem_init(&mutex, 0, 1);  /* 初始化为 1 */
    /* ... Fork ... Join ... */
    printf("cnt = %ld\n", cnt);  /* 精确 200000 */
}
```

**Fork-Join + 同步 = 正确的并行程序**。这是并发编程的第一公式。

## §2 Fork-Join 的形式化定义（第一性原理）

### 2.1 严格 Fork-Join 语义

C++ 标准提案 N4088[^N4088] 区分了两种语义：

[^N4088]: Halpern, P. et al. (2014). "Task Region R3". N4088. ISO/IEC JTC1/SC22/WG21.

| 语义 | 规则 | 代表语言 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **fully-strict** | 父任务必须等所有**直接**子任务完成后才能结束 | Cilk, Cilk Plus |
| **terminally-strict** | 子任务可以 join 到祖先任务，不必是直接父任务 | X10, Habanero, OpenMP |

CSAPP 教的 POSIX 线程 Fork-Join 是 **terminally-strict** 的——线程池中的线程是"对等的"（peer），不存在严格的父子层次。

### 2.2 分治递归形式

Fork-Join 最自然的表达是递归分治（Wikipedia 伪码）：

```
solve(problem):
    if problem is small enough:
        solve it sequentially
    else:
        for part in subdivide(problem):
            fork subtask to solve(part)
        join all subtasks
        combine results
```

**经典实例**：并行归并排序（CLRS）就是 Fork-Join 的递归版本[^CLRS]。

[^CLRS]: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, Stein. *Introduction to Algorithms*, 3/e. §27.3.

```c
void parallel_mergesort(int *A, int lo, int hi) {
    if (hi - lo <= THRESHOLD) {
        sequential_mergesort(A, lo, hi);
        return;
    }
    int mid = lo + (hi - lo) / 2;
    /* Fork: 左半在另一个线程中执行 */
    pthread_t tid;
    Pthread_create(&tid, NULL, merge_sort_thread, 
                   &(Args){A, lo, mid});
    /* 右半在当前线程中执行（不浪费当前 CPU） */
    parallel_mergesort(A, mid, hi);
    /* Join: 等待左半完成 */
    Pthread_join(tid, NULL);
    /* 合并两个有序子数组 */
    merge(A, lo, mid, hi);
}
```

**关键设计决策**：不 fork 两个子任务然后闲着——当前线程也处理一个子任务。这是 Fork-Join 效率的核心。

## §3 典型应用场景

### 3.1 科学计算：数据并行

将大矩阵按行分块，每个线程计算一块：

```c
#define N 640
#define THREADS 16
#define ROWS_PER_THREAD (N / THREADS)

int A[N][M], B[M][N], C[N][N];  /* C = A × B */

void *matmul_thread(void *vargp) {
    int start = *(int *)vargp;
    for (int i = start; i < start + ROWS_PER_THREAD; i++)
        for (int k = 0; k < M; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++)
                C[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j];
    return NULL;
}

int main() {
    pthread_t tid[THREADS];
    int ids[THREADS];
    for (int t = 0; t < THREADS; t++) {
        ids[t] = t * ROWS_PER_THREAD;
        Pthread_create(&tid[t], NULL, matmul_thread, &ids[t]);
    }
    for (int t = 0; t < THREADS; t++)
        Pthread_join(tid[t], NULL);
}
```

CSAPP 习题 12.34 做了这件事，Benchmark 数据[^CSAPP1234]：

| 线程数 | 核心数 | 时间 Tp (s) | 加速比 Sp | 效率 Ep |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | 1 | 0.86 | 1.00 | 100% |
| 2 | 2 | 0.466 | 1.84 | 92.2% |
| 4 | 4 | 0.626 | 1.37 | 34.3% |
| 8 | 4 | 0.627 | 1.37 | 34.3% |
| 16 | 4 | 0.628 | 1.37 | 34.3% |

> **教训**：线程数超过物理核心数后，加速比不再提升。Fork-Join 不是无成本魔法——线程切换开销和缓存竞争限制了可扩展性。

[^CSAPP1234]: CSAPP 3/e, Problem 12.34, DreamAndDead Solutions.

### 3.2 MapReduce：分治思想的分布式 Fork-Join

Map 阶段 = Fork（把数据分片给多个 worker），Reduce 阶段 = Join（收集结果并合并）。Google 的 MapReduce（2004）本质上就是 Fork-Join 在集群上的实现。

### 3.3 OpenMP：编译器级 Fork-Join

OpenMP 是科学计算领域标准的 Fork-Join 框架[^OpenMP]：

```c
#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+:sum)
for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    sum += f(i);
/* 编译器自动生成 Fork、分派迭代、Join、归约的代码 */
```

OpenMP 的 `#pragma omp parallel` = Fork，`#pragma omp parallel` 块结束 = Join（隐含 barrier）。

[^OpenMP]: Dagum, L. & Menon, R. (1998). "OpenMP: An Industry-Standard API for Shared-Memory Programming." *IEEE Computational Science & Engineering*.

## §4 关键设计问题

### 4.1 任务切分（Load Balancing）

Fork-Join 的效率取决于"切得是否均匀"。如果某个线程处理的数据量是其他线程的 10 倍，其他线程都会在 Join 时干等——Amdahl 定律的束缚。

**策略**：

| 策略 | 适用场景 | 例子 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| 静态均分 | 每个子任务工作量相同 | 矩阵乘法、向量加法 |
| 动态分配 | 子任务工作量不可预测 | Web 爬虫、Monte Carlo |
| Work-stealing | 递归分治 | Cilk、Java ForkJoinPool |

### 4.2 结果合并（Reduction）

Join 后需要把各线程的局部结果合并为全局结果：

| 归约操作 | 例子 |
|:---|:---|
| 加和 | 并行计数、向量点积 |
| 求最值 | 并行搜索最大/最小元素 |
| 拼接 | 并行排序后的子数组合并 |
| 逻辑合取/析取 | 并行检查条件 |

### 4.3 异常处理

如果一个子线程失败了怎么办？

- **POSIX 线程**：没有内置异常传播机制。通常用共享标志或 `pthread_exit` 返回值来指示错误。
- **Java ForkJoinPool**：`ForkJoinTask` 可以通过 `get()` 抛出子任务的异常。
- **C++ std::async**：`std::future::get()` 会重新抛出子任务的异常。

## §5 与其他并发模型的对比

| 维度 | Fork-Join | 生产者-消费者 | 事件驱动（异步 I/O） |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **本质** | 一个任务分成 N 份，同时做 | 一个生产，一个消费 | 一个线程处理多个 fd |
| **线程关系** | 等所有完成才继续 | 通过缓冲区解耦 | 单线程事件循环 |
| **同步点** | Join（barrier） | 缓冲区满/空 | select/poll/epoll_wait |
| **适用场景** | CPU 密集型并行计算 | 流水线、Web 请求分发 | I/O 密集型高并发 |
| **CSAPP 参考** | badcnt/goodcnt, 12.34 | §12.5.3 生产者-消费者 | §12.2 I/O 多路复用 |

### 一句话区分

> Fork-Join 是"分给所有人一起干，干完汇总"；生产者-消费者是"我生产你消费，大家各忙各的"；事件驱动是"一个人盯着十个锅，哪个开了处理哪个"。

## §6 工作窃取（Work-Stealing）：Fork-Join 的工业级实现

Doug Lea 的 Java Fork/Join 框架论文[^Lea2000] 和 Cilk 语言[^Cilk] 引入了**工作窃取调度器**，使 Fork-Join 从一种"模式"升级为一种"运行时系统"。

[^Lea2000]: Lea, D. (2000). "A Java Fork/Join Framework". *ACM Conference on Java*.
[^Cilk]: Frigo, M., Leiserson, C., & Randall, K. (1998). "The Implementation of the Cilk-5 Multithreaded Language". *PLDI 1998*.

### 核心机制

```
每个 worker 线程维护自己的双端队列（deque）：
  - push/pop：从队尾添加/取出（LIFO，处理自己的最新任务）
  - steal：从队头偷取（FIFO，偷别人最老的任务）

当 worker 的队列空了 → 从其他 worker 的队头随机偷一个任务
```

### 为什么需要它？

POSIX 线程 Fork-Join 的朴素实现（每任务创建一个线程）在高负载下有两个致命问题：

1. **线程创建开销**：`pthread_create` 涉及内核态操作（栈分配、TCB 初始化）——每个任务 ~8 MiB 栈
2. **任务粒度困境**：任务切太细 → 创建开销淹没收益；任务切太粗 → 负载不均

工作窃取解决了这两个问题——用固定大小的线程池，通过轻量级任务队列调度，将 Fork-Join 逻辑与 OS 线程解耦。

> **这就是为什么 Wikipedia 说**："Implementations of the fork–join model will typically fork tasks, fibers or lightweight threads, **not** operating-system-level heavyweight threads."

## §8 从第一性原理总结

Fork-Join 的本质是将**"串行算法并行化"** 这个问题分解为三个正交的决策：

1. **切分**（Partition）：如何把数据或工作分成独立的部分？
2. **分派**（Dispatch）：如何把各部分交给不同的执行单元？
3. **归约**（Reduce）：如何把各部分的结果合并成一个？

这三个决策对应了 Fork-Join 的三个阶段：**Fork**（分派）、**并行执行**（切分的结果）、**Join**（归约）。

> 如果你能回答这三个问题，你就能把任何串行算法改写成 Fork-Join 的并行版本。这就是 CSAPP 第 12 章教给你的核心能力——**不是记住 API，而是学会分解问题的思维**。
